title: 第5章 仙缘难得

第5章 仙缘难得
“当年与山越交战，山越中巫觋众多，驱使瘴疠蛇虫，军中发放此等符箓抵御巫术，这符箓救我一命，如今已是神光不显，如同破纸一张，这是其二。”
“山越好配兽骨，羽毛，琉璃，我杀了人，从尸体上搜刮来这些值钱物什，这是其三”
“明天我会拿这块琉璃，对你二伯说这是项平从河里捡来的，不管李叶盛见没见着，我们一口咬定就是一枚碎琉璃，不过在月光下闪烁罢了。”
李木田取出一块碎琉璃，将物品收拾好，对着李通崖轻声说。
“父亲想得周到。”李长湖点点头“二伯为人宽厚，识大体重大局，不会计较什么的。”
“可惜李叶盛是个废物。”李通崖轻声说，偏过头看着父亲。
李木田端起鉴子，将其放在木桌上，摇了摇头。
“现在要看这宝贝如何用，怎么用，搞不好竹篮打水一场空。”
陆江仙在镜中听了一路，心中有了计较，自己在镜中动弹不得，保护自己也好，从镜中脱困也罢，若要在漫漫仙路中找到一条自己也能走通的道路，少不得借助这方水土的人力与物力。
李家农户出身，根底浅薄，偏偏几人都出类拔萃。
两人会意，一弯腰迅速消失在浓密的芦苇荡里。
“你小子给我滚过来！”
“哥，它亮了！”李项平压着声兴奋地说。..c o
“两百年了。”
————
“父亲，此物无论从何处抚过，亮起的毫光皆指向北方。就像……”李通崖望着手里的鉴子凝重地开口。
“通崖有分寸。”
李木田脸上浮现出爽朗的笑颜，大步走到台前，将腊肉往木台上一放。
李叶盛歪头看着院门，弟弟李叶生怯生生地进了门，他眼神一瞪，大声骂道：

李叶盛抹着眼进了自家前院，骂骂咧咧地踢着路上的石子儿。
他取来腊肉，折下一块细细地切了小碟，咸菜炒了炒也端成小碟。两人搬了小案，倒了两小盏米酒，坐在门前就聊了起来。
到了村口，李木田四处望了望，拍拍李通崖与李项平的肩膀，低声说：
院门猛然
他明白，今夜他有可能失去两个孩子，却依旧留有李长湖为嗣。但孩子也许会平安归来，给李家带来飞黄腾达的机遇，他深深痛苦地愧疚着，攥紧了拳头。
李木田捋了捋胡须，又转头进了屋，招呼着几个孩子
“取一挂腊肉来，咱去拜访先生。”
“去。”
“先生。”
李通崖却轻咦一声，从大哥手中接过鉴子，背对着众人一抚。
“早应嘱咐他们两人，若有神异之事，远远望去就退回，不可留恋。”
“听说你和李项平那狗东西关系好，明天你去他家偷两个瓜来吃吃。”他恶狠狠地骂着。
————
镜中的陆江仙不禁大鼓掌，这小子真聪明，一点就通！
“先去村口。”
“这怎么好意思。”韩文许笑着点点头
“这天上高来高去的仙人们可算不来了。”李木田长出一口气，流露出轻松的神色。
李木田眯着眼，一切计算浮光掠影般浮现在心中。
李木田与李长湖皆抚了鉴子，啧啧称赞。
李木田带着三个孩子从村尾走到村头，路中倚在门槛上休息的村民笑着招呼:

“木田叔！往哪儿去～”
“李木田出去鬼混了二十来年，身上好东西可不少！可不是有宝贝呢。”他悄悄打着算盘。
“李兄！”
屋内李家兄弟围着鉴子捣鼓了半天一无所获，小心翼翼生怕磕坏了没了仙缘，这月华摸上去如水一般清凉舒适，却吹也不动吸也不动。
李通崖近身一看，镜身左上角亮起一道亮白色光弧，两边薄中间厚，煞是好看，数个呼吸后方才缓缓黯淡。
李通崖接过鉴子，学着李项平一般在镜面上一抚，果然亮起一道白光。他将鉴子往父亲手中一递，示意同他一般做。
韩文许耸了耸肩，然后啧啧称羡地答复道：“仙人啊！”
“我十二岁那年，镇里来了个仙人。”他抿了抿嘴，惆怅地说着：
父亲李木田胆魄见识具上佳，长子李长湖处事圆滑为人宽厚，次子李通崖勇敏果断敢打敢拼，李项平与李尺泾也是机敏灵巧之辈，实在是结合的上上之选。
李木田忧虑地望望远方，长子不禁提醒道：
“揣着啥宝贝呢，几个瓜还当宝了，几个龟龟大半夜提着刀来看，心里有鬼欸！”他坐在石头上，心中一动。
“偏偏那几个龟龟还脾气倔硬，指头缝都扣不出泥来，老头又老又犟，死都不肯开口，不然李木田一死，东西咱都要有份！”
直到李项平拿起鉴子，在镜面上轻轻一抚，陆江仙运气催动，镜面左上角骤然亮起，吓得李项平一颤，连声呼唤，拿也不是，放也不是。
更何况他没手没腿，走不了也跑不了，也别说换人了，难道他默不作声当做垃圾重新丢进河里，如同囚禁一般沉默百年？
“无论如何，先去东边看看，哪怕是远远的看一眼也好。”想到这儿，陆江仙催动体内的气流往镜身左上角涌动。
李家在这块土地上面朝黄土背朝天整整两百年了，面对可能存在的机缘，李木田理智地做出了符合家族利益的选择，却又在情感上痛苦不已。
“给先生送点东西！”
李木田笑着提了提手中的腊肉。
“司南。”李木田点点头。
“他说要找开窍之人，全镇一千多位幼儿，仅仅寻得三位开窍之人，带着三位走了。如今天上高来高去的仙人，说不定就有我的同乡。”

他扯着弟弟的衣服往屋前一掷，李叶生在地上狼狈地打了个滚，害怕地缩成一团。
“仙缘难得啊！”李木田沉默许久，安慰道。
“仙缘难得，仙缘难得啊……”
韩文许愣愣地望着天上的月亮，口中不断重复着这句话。
两人各怀心事，忧虑重重地沉默着。
(本章完)

Chapter 5 Immortal fate is rare
"Back then, during the battle with Shanyue, there were many witches and demons in Shanyue, driving away miasma, snakes and insects. The army issued these talismans to resist witchcraft. This talisman saved my life. Now it has lost its divine light, just like a piece of broken paper. This is the second one."
"The better the mountain, the better it is with animal bones, feathers, and colored glaze. I killed people and looted these valuables from the corpses. This is the third one."
"Tomorrow I will take this piece of glass and tell your second uncle that Xiang Ping picked it up from the river. Regardless of whether Li Yesheng saw it or not, we insist that it is just a piece of broken glass, just shining in the moonlight."
Li Mutian took out a piece of broken glass, put the items away, and whispered to Li Tongya.
"Father is thoughtful." Li Changhu nodded, "Second uncle is a generous man, understands the overall situation, and doesn't care about anything."
"It's a pity that Li Yesheng is a waste." Li Tongya said softly, turning his head to look at his father.
Li Mutian picked up the plate, placed it on the wooden table, and shook his head.
"Now it depends on how to use this treasure, how to use it, maybe it will be all in vain."
Lu Jiangxian listened all the way in the mirror, and had some thoughts in his mind. He couldn't move in the mirror, whether it was to protect himself or to escape from the mirror, if he wanted to find a path that he could walk on the long road to immortality, he would have to rely on the human and material resources of this land and water.
The Li family was born in a farmer's family and had a shallow foundation, but a few people were outstanding.
The two understood each other, bent down and quickly disappeared into the thick reeds.
"Get over here, kid!"
"Brother, it's on!" Li Xiangping said excitedly in a low voice. ..c o
"Two hundred years."
————
"Father, no matter where you touch this object, the light it emits points to the north. Just like..." Li Tongya looked at the jianzi in his hand and spoke solemnly.
"Tongya has a sense of proportion."
A hearty smile appeared on Li Mutian's face, he strode to the stage and placed the bacon on the wooden platform.
Li Yesheng tilted his head and looked at the courtyard door. His younger brother Li Yesheng timidly entered the door. He glared and cursed loudly:
Li Yesheng wiped his eyes and entered the front yard of his house, kicking the stones on the road while cursing.
He took the bacon, broke off a piece and cut it into small plates, fried the pickles and served them on small plates. The two moved the small case, poured two small cups of rice wine, sat in front of the door and started chatting.
Arriving at the entrance of the village, Li Mutian looked around, patted Li Tongya and Li Xiangping on the shoulders, and whispered:
The courtyard door suddenly
He understood that he might lose two children tonight, but he would still have Li Changhu as his heir. But the child might return safely and bring opportunities for the Li family to prosper. He felt deeply painfully guilty and clenched his fists.
Li Mutian stroked his beard, then turned around and entered the house, greeting several children.
"Bring me a bunch of bacon and let's go visit sir."
"Go."
"Sir."
Li Tongya sighed softly, took the jianzi from his elder brother, and touched it with his back to everyone.
"I should have told the two of them long ago that if there is anything supernatural, they should retreat when they see it from a distance and not linger."
"I heard that you have a good relationship with that bitch Li Xiangping. Tomorrow you go to his house and steal two melons to eat." He cursed fiercely.
————
Lu Jiangxian in the mirror couldn't help but applaud, this guy is so smart, he can do it all with just one click!
"Go to the village entrance first."
"How embarrassing." Han Wenxu smiled and nodded.
"The immortals who come and go in the sky are not here." Li Mutian took a long breath and showed a relaxed look.
Li Mutian squinted his eyes, and all his calculations came to mind like a fleeting glimpse.
Li Mutian and Li Changhu both stroked the jianzi and praised it.
Li Mutian walked with three children from the end of the village to the end of the village. On the way, a villager resting on the threshold smiled and greeted:
"Uncle Kida! Where are you going~"
"Li Mutian has been out fooling around for more than twenty years, and he has a lot of good things! It's not like he has treasures." He quietly calculated.
"Brother Li!"
inside the houseThe Li brothers fiddled with the jianzi for a long time and found nothing. They were careful for fear of damaging it and losing the immortality. The moonlight felt as cool and comfortable as water, but they could not be blown or inhaled.
Li Tongya took a closer look, and saw a bright white arc of light lit up in the upper left corner of the mirror. It was thin on both sides and thick in the middle. It was really beautiful. It slowly dimmed after a few breaths.
Li Tongya took the mirror and followed Li Xiangping's example in stroking the mirror, and sure enough, a white light lit up. He handed the jianzi to his father's hand and gestured to do the same as him.
Han Wenxu shrugged, then replied with admiration: "Immortal!"
"When I was twelve years old, an immortal came to town." He pursed his lips and said melancholy:
His father, Li Mutian, was courageous and knowledgeable, his eldest son, Li Changhu, was smooth and generous, his second son, Li Tongya, was brave, smart, decisive and brave enough to fight. Li Xiangping and Li Chijing were also smart and clever people, so they were the perfect choice for their union.
Li Mutian looked into the distance worriedly, and his eldest son couldn't help but remind him:
"What kind of treasure are you carrying? A few melons are regarded as treasures, and a few turtles are holding knives to look at them in the middle of the night. They have ghosts in their hearts!" He sat on the stone and felt something in his heart.
"It just so happens that those turtles are so stubborn that they can't even squeeze the mud out of their fingers. The old man is so old and stubborn that he won't even open his mouth. Otherwise, if Li Mutian dies, we will all have a share of everything!"
Until Li Xiangping picked up the mirror and touched it gently on the mirror, Lu Jiangxian's luck moved, and the upper left corner of the mirror suddenly lit up. Li Xiangping trembled in fright and shouted repeatedly, neither taking it nor putting it down.
What's more, he has no arms or legs, can't walk or run, let alone change people. Could he be silent and thrown into the river again as garbage, and be silent for a hundred years like a prisoner?
"No matter what, let's go to the east and take a look first, even from a distance." Thinking of this, Lu Jiangxian activated the airflow in his body to surge towards the upper left corner of the mirror body.
The Li family has been on this land for two hundred years. Faced with possible opportunities, Li Mutian rationally made a choice that was in the interests of the family, but he was emotionally painful.
"Send something to sir!"
Li Mutian smiled and lifted the bacon in his hand.
"Si Nan." Li Mutian nodded.
"He said he was looking for someone who could enlighten him. Of the more than a thousand children in the town, he only found three enlightened people and took three of them away. Nowadays, among the immortals who come and go in the sky, some of my fellow villagers may be included."
He grabbed his brother's clothes and threw them in front of the house. Li Yesheng rolled on the ground in a panic, huddled in fear.
"Immortal fate is rare!" Li Mutian was silent for a long time and consoled him.
"Immortal fate is rare, fairy fate is rare..."
Han Wenxu stared blankly at the moon in the sky and kept repeating these words.
The two of them had their own thoughts and were silent in worry.
(End of chapter)
